rules.title: Income rules
rules.intro1: Buckets with the refill mode “On income” aren't refilled when a new cycle starts. They wait until your income, such as your salary, arrives, so you only budget money you have.
rules.intro2: An income that matches a rule refills the “On income” buckets funded from the account it's paid into. To match, it must come from the counterparty (case doesn't matter) and be at least the minimum. Each bucket is refilled at most once per cycle, so a second payment in the same cycle doesn't refill it again.
rules.intro3: On each income you can also tick “Triggers refill” yourself, or untick it to skip a rule that matches.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Without rules, “On income” buckets are only refilled by an income where you tick “Triggers refill”.
